name: lightnovel-immersive-reader
description: A Tampermonkey userscript that injects a clean, Google-Docs-style immersive reader into lightnovel.fun — auto/manual chapterization, per-chapter bookmarks, a Sublime-style minimap, themes, resume-from-LK-history, and one-click EPUB/TXT export or send-to-Calibre with rule-based + optional LLM metadata.
